unit_of_analysis: Institution, counted once per documented support function

roles.label: Competition access or delivery
roles.definition: Explicitly organises athletics competition or provides a programme through which athletes participate in competition. A general interest in sport is insufficient.

roles.label: Athlete training
roles.definition: Explicitly describes athlete training or an athletics development and training programme. Funding training alone does not qualify.

roles.label: Coach or official education
roles.definition: Explicitly offers education, certification, or development for coaches or athletics officials. General academic study alone does not qualify.

roles.label: Facilities or infrastructure support
roles.definition: Explicitly provides athletics facilities or funds sports infrastructure. The code does not establish access, condition, capacity, or utilisation.

roles.label: Financial support
roles.definition: Explicitly funds sports organisations, programmes, or athletes, including scholarships. This code describes a documented mechanism, not a funding amount.

roles.label: Governance or representation
roles.definition: Explicitly acts as the national athletics governing body or the national Olympic committee. Other regulatory activity is coded separately under clean sport.

roles.label: Health or welfare support
roles.definition: Explicitly describes athlete well-being services, sports medicine, or an athlete welfare fund. It does not establish a medical benefit.

roles.label: Clean sport education or testing
roles.definition: Explicitly describes anti-doping education or testing for athletes or their support personnel.

coding_rule: Assign a role only when an included primary source explicitly supports it. Absence of a code means not established in this bounded corpus, not that the institution lacks the function.
sampling_rule: Purposive sample spanning school competition, tertiary institutions, national athletics administration, and cross-sport support. This is not a census or a representative sample.
